observations: Open, release, and input-device removal serialize access to the active per-device file context using rdbg_file_lifecycle_lock.
Where both locks are needed, lifecycle lock precedes input IRQ lock; the probe publication path takes only the input IRQ lock, so no reverse lock order was found.
Input removal marks the IRQ unavailable, marks the active file context offline, wakes blocked readers, and calls free_irq before releasing the lifecycle lock.
Read checks the offline marker both before waiting and after waking; release skips free_irq when remove has already invalidated the per-file IRQ snapshot.
Device minor bounds are checked before array indexing, and the module initialization guard constrains the device count to the 16-entry device table.
